about: Listings to take off the site. Duplicates and replaced venues are redirected to the listing that stays (POST /admin/retire-duplicate), so old links keep working. A closed venue with nothing to redirect to is deleted. Applied with scripts/apply-listing-removals.js.

redirect.reason: Same restaurant at 152 Riverside Dr listed twice; the kept listing has the phone number and reviews.
Frog City Cafe is the café at Linden Gardens; frogcitycafe.ca redirects to lindengardens.ca/frog-city-cafe.
The Vernon Dosa Crepe Café closed in May 2026; Flamez Chicken now runs at the same address (3101 BC-6 #104) and phone number.

delete.reason: Closed: the property is listed for sale or lease as a former boutique winery, and there is no successor venue to redirect to.
